video_title: Did Jaylen Brown Just Disrespect Jayson Tatum?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins addresses Jaylen Brown's comments about feeling disrespected
quotes.excerpt: I've been a fan of Jaylen Brown. I've been a fan of Jaylen Brown... arguably the best two-way player.
quotes.quote: This is the growth in me. Obviously Jaylen Brown's dad went on a podcast and he had some things to say to me about me changing on his son. That's irrelevant. Let me say this: number one, I'm a fan of Jaylen Brown. I've been a fan of Jaylen Brown. You can go check my X account and all the way since back when, I've been talking about Jaylen Brown being arguably the best two-way player in the game. This year, I voted for Jaylen Brown first team All-NBA. There's a tweet out there where he said he felt kind of disrespected. This is not an accurate quote, but it's along the lines of because he felt like the world is against him. Well, I wasn't. I actually voted you first team All-NBA. Secondly, I actually voted you fourth on my MVP ballot over Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson criticizes the timing of Jaylen Brown's podcast comments
quotes.excerpt: It's just not the right time to say that, especially when you're in Boston.
quotes.quote: It's just not the right time to say that, especially when you're in Boston and you have championship expectations. It just seemed very selfish. Now, did we watch the whole stream? No. But do things get clipped? Yes. That shouldn't be. It's just not the right time. If he would have said, 'Hey, this just wasn't the right timing, I should have prefaced by saying me individually, what I've accomplished this year was to show people I could do it myself,' that's very different.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye praises Jaylen Brown's performance and leadership
quotes.excerpt: Nobody has won more games since he entered into the league in the last 10 years.
quotes.quote: For Jaylen Brown, there was always something that was looming big in his career. He was a champion, he was a Finals MVP, he was a conference MVP. He's been to the Finals multiple times. He put out a tweet that I'm actually quite proud of him: nobody has won more games since he entered into the league in the last 10 years. That's a fact. But there was one thing that I feel like might have been not necessarily missing from his resume, but yet to accomplish: could he lead a team for 82?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson discusses the media narrative surrounding Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: The whole Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum thing, it's been a discussion: can this work?
quotes.quote: When you are accessible like that and when you speak, especially the way he does, as an intelligent young man, sometimes how he's speaking is going to get clipped. I think sometimes he may not need to go live all the time. We've been doing this a long time, and so there are some thoughts that I go, 'You know what, maybe I should just hold that thought off for a second and then get all the facts.' I think Jaylen Brown, here's what's interesting from the media side: the whole Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum thing, it's been a discussion: can this work? It did work. It has been working. But there is always this little tension of Jayson Tatum not making the USA team or Jaylen Brown not making the USA team.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins reflects on media learning curves and team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: We all work in media. All three of us has bumped our heads.
quotes.quote: All three of us work in media. All three of us has bumped our heads where we didn't get called to the quote-unquote, I call the principal office. We've learned from that. All I'm saying is this: you can't, I'm not agreeing 24 hours after your team just blew a 3-1 lead, the first time in Celtics history. You got to let that sit out for a little bit. Because you was the dog leading in charge. That game seven of that series was on your home floor. Jayson Tatum was not available. So that game seven of that series was on your home floor.
